svg.desc: Drawn for this research: USS Haynsworth (DD-700) as her photographs show her in 1944-45 (US Navy photograph BS 68148, 21 June 1944, as reproduced on usndazzle.com; Navy Day at Kahului, 27 October 1945, on the Haynsworth Association's site), laid on the SUMNER class plate's positions and heights (ONI 222-US, 1 September 1945, p. 83); the plain two-tone scheme of the 1945 photograph. Not a recognition plate: a drawing of this one ship. Profile.
